/settlement/save.why: ADR-001 'Out of scope': the service is unauthenticated, so the session operator that SettlementSaveAction reads becomes an explicit request parameter. The transcript actor is sent as that parameter; the observable savedBy value is unchanged.

skips.payment_issue: Payment issue stays in the monolith: ADR-001 extracts only /settlement/calculate, /settlement/save and /settlement/detail; /claims/payment/issue.do has no service route.
skips.payment_history: Payment history stays in the monolith: /claims/payment/history.do has no service route (ADR-001 'Out of scope').

settlement.claim.<id>.amount.why: SETTLE-R30: detail returns the highest settlement_id for the claim, which is the row the save path just wrote. The identity is compared with the reading taken before the replay, so a row an earlier run left behind cannot stand in for a save that did not happen.

unprobeable.claim.<id>.status: The CLAIM table is outside the service boundary (ADR-001 'Out of scope'); the service exposes no claim-status read, and SETTLE-R24 records that the settlement paths never write it.
unprobeable.payment.<id>.<field>: The PAYMENT table is outside the service boundary.
unprobeable.payment.count.claim.<id>: The PAYMENT table is outside the service boundary.

approved_differences_comment: An approved difference replaces the transcript's expectations for that scenario: replay.py judges the response against the 'expected' block below instead, reports the scenario as CHANGED (<change>), and still FAILs on anything the record does not approve. Each entry must name a docs/changes/CHG-nnn record (ADR-001, 'Behaviour freeze').

approved_differences.summary: A non-blank, unparseable deductible is a validation error instead of the error screen

transcript_rules_comment: Which SPEC-SETTLE-001 rules each settlement transcript is evidence for, taken from the 'Observed:' lines of the spec. tools/traceability.py reads this to put transcripts and their parity verdicts next to each rule. An entry without a version (SETTLE-R05) applies to every version of that rule; a version-qualified entry (SETTLE-R06 (v2)) applies to that version only.
rules_exercised_comment: Every rule each scenario exercises, for the rules column of parity/report.md. This is wider than transcript_rules, which lists only the rules the spec cites the transcript as evidence for and is the map tools/traceability.py reads.
